claims.object_text: disinhibition of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway
claims.quote: Disinhibition of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway has been observed in patients with loss-of-function variants in the disheveled, Egl-10, and pleckstrin domain-containing protein 5 (DEPDC5), and nitrogen permease regulator-like proteins 2 and 3 (NPRL2, and NPRL3) genes, which encode the components of GTPase activating protein Activity Toward Rags Complex 1 (GATOR1) complex.

claims.object_text: GTPase activating protein Activity Toward Rags Complex 1 (GATOR1) complex
claims.quote: disheveled, Egl-10, and pleckstrin domain-containing protein 5 (DEPDC5), and nitrogen permease regulator-like proteins 2 and 3 (NPRL2, and NPRL3) genes, which encode the components of GTPase activating protein Activity Toward Rags Complex 1 (GATOR1) complex.
Everolimus, a synthetic mTOR inhibitor, has shown efficacy in treating seizures in patients with DEPDC5 epilepsy, but seemed to worsen seizures in the one published patient with NPRL3 epilepsy.
